_comment: Tier-2 for febio::rigid_body#3. Four variants of the shipped indentation deck: penalty 1 with auto_penalty off leaves more than 99% of the contact travel as interpenetration — as bad as having no <Contact> section at all; penalty 10000 (ten times E) is better but still far from closed; the shipped auto_penalty=1 with multiplier 10 gives the smallest residual. All four reach normal termination with exit 0 and all steps completed, and no warning distinguishes them. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'contact_penalty=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
